notablePrerequisites:
Karn is not your commander.
You control at least one additional artifact.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Karn triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1}, copying Karn's ability.
Resolve the copy of Karn's ability, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast nonartifact spells.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.
